meaning.en: A heavy or abrupt fall or collision.
meaning.vi: Một cú ngã hoặc va chạm nặng hoặc đột ngột.

meaning.en: The sound of this.

meaning.en: (chiefly brit., now dial.) A compact group; cluster.

meaning.en: (obsolete) A knot or cluster; a group; a crowd.
meaning.vi: (lỗi thời) Một nút hoặc một cụm; một nhóm; một đám đông.

meaning.en: The sound of a heavy fall or collision.

meaning.en: A falling, plunging, or colliding suddenly or heavily.

meaning.en: To give full support or praise.

meaning.en: To drop abruptly or heavily.

meaning.en: (intransitive) To grow plump; to swell out.

meaning.en: (intransitive) To give a plumper (kind of vote).

meaning.en: To give (a vote), as a plumper.

meaning.en: To become well-rounded, chubby, or full in form.

meaning.vi: Trực tiếp; đột ngột; vuông góc.
